Sales Quote

Sales quote footers allow you to add customizable text sections at the bottom of your sales quotes.

Create and manage multiple footer templates to use with different types of quotes, ensuring consistent messaging while maintaining flexibility.

Name
Name

Footers are text sections that appear at the bottom of your sales quotes, providing important terms and conditions to potential customers.

Common Uses

Footer content typically includes quote validity periods, pricing disclaimers, delivery terms, payment requirements, or special offers.

Different footer templates can be created for various products, services, or customer segments.

Using Footer Templates

When creating a sales quote, you can select the appropriate footer template from your saved templates.

This ensures consistency in your quotations while allowing flexibility for different situations.

Enter a descriptive name for each footer template to easily identify its purpose, such as 'Standard Quote Terms' or 'Project-Based Services'.
